events.description: Initialization of the 3D scene with a ChargedParticle at the origin and its AccelerationVector.
events.clip_query: A 3D red sphere representing a positive charged particle with a pink acceleration vector pointing from its center.

events.description: The charged particle starts moving along a 3D trajectory (e.g., helical or sinusoidal path).
events.clip_query: A red charged particle moving along a curved path in 3D space.

events.description: The 3D camera rotates to show the movement from different spatial angles.
events.clip_query: The camera rotating around a moving 3D particle in a dark space.

events.description: The acceleration vector dynamically updates its direction and magnitude based on the particle's motion.
events.clip_query: A pink vector attached to a moving sphere dynamically changing its length and direction.
